_note: Scoring only. Never put this file in the agent's input.
mechanism: The orders-archive batch job, manually triggered at 14:01, holds row locks on the orders table. Checkout queries wait on those locks, connections are held about 50x longer, and the pool fills on every instance regardless of version.
